title: What is Project Knowledge?

body.text: Project Knowledge means adding reference files or documents into a Project so Claude can use them as a
permanent knowledge base throughout the Project
. You can upload files like a style guide, company info, FAQs, or API documentation. After that, Claude will
in every conversation in the Project — no need to resend the files.

example: "[Add Brand Guideline.pdf to Project Knowledge] Draft an Instagram post for our new campaign, following the brand voice in the file I gave you."

title: Manage Project Knowledge effectively

body.text: Managing your knowledge files well makes Claude more accurate. Include only
information that's frequently used and important to the work
. For a writing Project, add a style guide and target-audience profile; for a software Project, add the tech stack and coding standards. You can
update or delete knowledge files anytime
, and the change takes effect in the next conversation.

example: "Here's the latest competitor analysis [upload file]. Update the Project Knowledge, then recommend the strategy we should focus on."

options.text: It gives Claude a permanent reference knowledge base without resending files each time

options.text: Spec documents, example code, and coding guidelines

options.text: In the next conversation of that Project
